          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-shell-syntax.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-git.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/run-all-validations.sh
          
          # Run comprehensive validation
          ./scripts/run-all-validations.sh

      - name: Run Shellcheck
        uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
        with:
          sh_checker_exclude: "*/node_modules/*,*/.git/*"
          sh_checker_shellcheck_disable: false
          sh_checker_shfmt_disable: true
          sh_checker_checkbashisms_enable: false
          sh_checker_comment: true
          sh_checker_only_diff: false

      - name: Validate Workflow Syntax
        uses: raven-actions/actionlint@v2
        with:
          fail-on-error: true
          shellcheck: true

yaml:
name: Validate Configuration
on:

    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Shellcheck
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck

      - name: Setup Fish
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y fish

      - name: Setup Zsh
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y zsh

      - name: Setup GNU Stow
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y stow

      - name: Run Validation Scripts
        run: |
          # Make validation scripts executable
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-abbreviations.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-environment.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-dependencies.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-symlinks.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-shell-syntax.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-git.sh
          chmod +x ./scripts/run-all-validations.sh
          
          # Run comprehensive validation
          ./scripts/run-all-validations.sh

          sh_checker_shfmt_disable: true
          sh_checker_checkbashisms_enable: false
